en: Jose Rizal was only 35 years old when he was executed by firing squad on December 30, 1896.
The Philippine Senate has 24 elected members, while the House of Representatives has over 300 members.
The Philippines has over 180 distinct languages, but Filipino and English are the two official national languages.
The Sinulog festival in Cebu attracts over 2 million visitors annually, making it one of the largest Philippine festivals.
The Ifugao people built the Banaue Rice Terraces, which are carved into mountains at an altitude of 1,500 meters.
Dr. Fe del Mundo practiced medicine for over 70 years, becoming the first female National Scientist in 2009.
The Philippines is an archipelago of 7,641 islands, which is 534 more islands than the previously believed count of 7,107.
Lapu-Lapu and his 1,500 warriors defeated Ferdinand Magellan and his Spanish forces in the Battle of Mactan in 1521.
The Philippine flag features eight sun rays, representing the first eight provinces that revolted against Spain in 1896.
The Philippine Constitution mandates that the President can only serve one single term of exactly six years.
The Las Piñas Bamboo Organ has 954 pipes and was built over six years, completing in 1824.
The Philippine K-12 basic education program requires students to complete 13 years of schooling, including kindergarten and senior high school.
